title: Nike and Formula 1 Join Forces in Long-Term Global Partnership
summary: United by a relentless drive to push boundaries, Nike and Formula 1 will bring new energy to the pinnacle of motorsport through product, innovations and race-weekend experiences designed to inspire the next generation of athletes and fans.
body_markdown:
Nike and Formula 1 are announcing a long-term partnership that brings together two of the world’s most influential brands at the intersection of sport, speed and culture.


United by a relentless drive to push boundaries, Nike and Formula 1 will bring new energy to the pinnacle of motorsport through product, innovations and race-weekend experiences designed to inspire the next generation of athletes and fans.


“Formula 1 is driven by competition, speed and a constant push to innovate," says Elliott Hill, President & CEO, NIKE, Inc. "That’s an athlete mindset, and it’s one we share at Nike. Together, we have an incredible opportunity to bring new energy to the sport, serve its athletes and inspire fans around the world.”


Starting with the 2027 race season, Nike will become an official partner of Formula 1 and the official apparel and uniform provider for Formula 1 staff at events worldwide.


For fans, Nike and Formula 1 will introduce sportswear collections that bring the speed, energy and attitude of racing into footwear, apparel and accessories designed to live on and off the track.


Fans will get an early look November 20, when a Nike x Las Vegas Grand Prix limited capsule collection debuts in Las Vegas during the race weekend. The collection will be available at the Nike Las Vegas store at Caesars Palace and the F1 Hub at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas.


The partnership will also reach beyond what fans wear. Nike and Formula 1 will create new race-weekend experiences, giving fans more ways to engage with the sport at the track and beyond. Additional product and experience details will be announced as the partnership develops.


“Formula 1 and Nike are two of the world’s most iconic brands, united by a relentless pursuit of what’s next,” says Stefano Domenicali, President & CEO, Formula 1. “Formula 1 is experiencing unprecedented global growth, reaching hundreds of millions of fans and engaging one of the most passionate, diverse and dynamic communities in sport. Nike’s unique ability to sit at the intersection of sport, culture and inspiration makes them the ideal partner as we enter our next chapter.”


The partnership further extends to F1 ACADEMY, the all-female racing series working to inspire and support young girls and women in motorsport around the world.


As the Official Sporting Apparel Partner of F1 ACADEMY, Nike will work closely with the sport’s next generation of athletes to reimagine what they need to perform at their best. Their insights will help shape the technology, design and style of future performance products created for the unique demands of racing.


“This is far more than a commercial partnership; it is the coming together of two brands that shape culture, challenge convention and set new standards of excellence,” says Domenicali. “We are only at the start of what we can achieve together, and the possibilities ahead are truly limitless.”


The Nike x Formula 1 partnership will continue to grow across product, athlete innovation and race-weekend experiences, with more details to be shared throughout the 2027 season and beyond.
